IT’S EVEN MORE “YOU”
The collection of authentic Mopar® accessories
will pack your FIAT® vehicle with even more
punch. From custom graphics like the available
Premier Edition Bodyside Stripe (shown) to
unique wheels like the 16-inch Gloss Black
Painted Wheel (shown) to equipment carriers
THE FIAT® 500
and storage solutions, Mopar has what you
need to get the most out of your vehicle.
CABRIO LOUNGE:
See a full listing of accessories at mopar.com
WHERE THE
VENUE IS AS
IMPRESSIVE AS
THE SHOW.
While the FIAT 500 Cabrio makes the most
of the great outdoors by providing spectacular
vistas, it also focuses inward to include driver
and passenger amenities making any trip special.
An innovative three-position power-folding
retractable soft top opens on the fly — even
at speeds up to 60 mph. Its preset positions
offer a range of stopping points from slightly
open to fully dropped. This dual-layer cloth
top is available in a choice of three colors,
improving views from both inside and out.
The Cabrio Lounge only adds to the splendor
with the luxury of leather-trimmed seating,
automatic temperature control, state-of-
the-art technology, premium audio options
and more. Clearly, this convertible doesn’t
just rely on good views alone.
FIAT 500 Lounge Cabrio shown in Pompei Silver with Beige soft top and optional Premier Edition Bodyside Stripe and unique 16-inch Gloss Black Painted Wheel by Mopar®.
